originalObservation.impact: Draft line 69 lists "Insomnia, forty-plus hours" among current adverse-withdrawal cases. Draft line 3 sets the scene "By six in the morning" on the first distribution day, and line 65 says Kestrel General entered the withdrawal list at 06:40 that same morning. Under the supplied premise (L-9 and rule:mask_premise), masks become available on that first day; a patient cannot have 40+ hours of withdrawal insomnia by 06:40 on the first day unless they had already been without the Lull for 40+ hours before masks existed. The same patient and time cannot both just begin mask use that morning and have 40+ hours of withdrawal insomnia.

recheck.note: Line 69 now reads only "Convulsions. Rigidity. Tremor. Insomnia." with no forty-plus-hour duration, so the impossible withdrawal timeline on the first distribution morning is gone.
